messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@medorahealth.com>, Ben Howard <ben.howard@medorahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff - Medora Health (post-call recap & next steps)

Hi Alicia / Ben,

Thanks for taking the time today — quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned as we kick off the security review.

Recap: 
- Primary use case: embed Redwood API for patient-facing summarization in Medora's clinician portal (no PHI stored long-term in Redwood; transiently processed).
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: SOC 2, HIPAA support/BAA, latency <= 150ms p50, data residency (US), and predictable pricing for production scale.
- Stakeholders we heard on the call: Ben Howard (CFO / economic buyer), Rahul Singh (Head of Security), Alicia (Product / procurement lead).

Immediate next steps:
1) Please complete the attached Medora security questionnaire so our security team has your baseline answers (attachment: Medora_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx).
2) We'll scope systems in-scope for the review: production API endpoints, telemetry/logs (S3), and any SSO/integration surfaces (Auth / SAML). Please confirm if your audit/analytics DB is considered in-scope or if data stays in your environment only.
3) Neha will follow up on contract/procurement timeline and pricing expectations.
4) Sean will propose a short technical walkthrough for your security and infra teams to cover network/topology, auth, and logging.

Can you confirm the list of internal stakeholders who should be looped into the questionnaire follow-up (security, legal, procurement)? Also please indicate an approximate procurement window (we discussed Q2/Q3).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: Medora_Security_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx

Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff - Medora Health (post-call recap & next steps)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Attaching the filled questionnaire (Medora_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx). A few clarifications from our side: 

- Stakeholders to include now: Ben Howard (CFO / economic buyer), Rahul Singh (Head of Security), Priya Patel (Legal counsel) — cc’ing Rahul but I’ll loop Priya after we align on next steps.
- Procurement timeline: target contract execution by end of Q2; procurement lead is procurement@medorahealth.com (they manage PO + redlines).
- Systems in-scope: Production API endpoints (hosted by Redwood), inbound data flows from our portal, S3 audit logs where we'll mirror request logs for retention, and SAML SSO integration. Our analytics DB remains in our VPC and is out of scope — we only send aggregated, non-identifiable metrics to Redwood.
- Compliance must include HIPAA considerations — we will need to evaluate a BAA as part of procurement.

Open Qs for your team: 
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a US-only data residency (we prefer no cross-region backups outside US)?
2) What is your SOC 2 report date / audit window?

Thanks — attaching the questionnaire. Let us know a few times for the technical walkthrough next week.

Best,
Alicia Torres
Product Lead, Integrations
Medora Health

Attachments: Medora_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@medorahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Howard <ben.howard@medorahealth.com>, Rahul Singh <rahul.singh@medorahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff - Medora Health (scope & next steps)

Alicia — thanks for the quick turnaround and the completed questionnaire, that’s super helpful. A few clarifications from our side based on your answers: 

- Data residency: Redwood supports region pinning for hosted deployments. We can ensure data and backups remain in US regions (we'll note this as a requirement for the SOC/BAA write-up).
- SOC 2: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers Sep 2026–Feb 2027; we’ll share the redacted report with you via secure link once we complete the intake.
- HIPAA / BAA: We do offer a BAA for customers processing PHI. Our security team will draft standard language and our legal team can engage on any necessary redline items.

Systems in-scope (proposed):
- Redwood production inference endpoints (API)
- Audit/logs export to S3 (we’ll share supported encryption and retention settings)
- SSO (SAML/OIDC) and user provisioning surface (SCIM optional)
- Key management: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Private deployments — we’ll clarify options for hosted vs dedicated vs private.

Action items / owners: 
- Marissa: coordinate security intake and share redacted SOC 2 and questionnaire response (attachment).
- Neha: confirm procurement/contract timeline and next steps with procurement@medorahealth.com.
- Sean: schedule technical walkthrough (network, VPC options, IP allowlists, SSO flow, logs).

I’ve attached the initial security intake we’ll complete on our side (redwood_security_questionnaire_response.pdf). If this scope looks correct, Sean — can you propose 30–45 minute slots for a technical walkthrough next week?

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood_security_questionnaire_response.pdf

Hi Alicia / team — Sean here (Customer Success). Happy to run the technical walkthrough and cover the implementation details. Proposed agenda (30–45m):

1) Architecture & data flow: how data moves between Medora portal -> Redwood inference -> audit logs (S3).
2) Auth & identity: SAML/OIDC integration details, support for SCIM, session TTLs, and admin controls.
3) Network & connectivity: IP ranges, VPC peering/dedicated private link options, and allowlist process.
4) Logging & retention: audit logs schema, encryption-at-rest, delivery (S3), and log retention policies.
5) Compliance & docs: SOC 2 redacted report, BAA overview, and next steps for legal review.

Prep requests: 
- If Rahul / security team have specific compliance checklist items, please share before the call so we can prepare concrete answers.
- Confirm whether you prefer Hosted with US-only region pinning or Dedicated/Private deployment (we’ll cover tradeoffs on the call).
- Please share preferred 30–45m slots next Tue/Wed (Mar 23/24) in your timezone.

I’ve attached a short technical checklist to frame the discussion (technical-checklist.xlsx).

Thanks — I’ll hold tentative time and once Alicia confirms we’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Sean Gallagher

Redwood Inference
